title: Escalation Ladder
short_answer: Who owns production, who owns scope and money, and when to stop climbing because the next person cannot actually authorize it.
summary: Who owns production, who owns scope and money, and when to stop climbing because the next person cannot actually authorize it.
plain_words: Call the person who can say yes. Calling the wrong person gets you a friendly answer that does not pay. When in doubt: lead first, then ops, then office for scope/money.
when_to_use: Any time you need authority today — stops, extras, conflicts, or access
Before calling the office for scope/money after the lead cannot decide
When you are unsure who can actually authorize the next move
prerequisites: Know who the lead and ops superintendent are on this job
Office contact for change orders and contractual notice

steps.title: Phone call
steps.body: Use for stops, change orders, and anything that needs authority today.

steps.title: Portal
steps.body: Use for Job Check truth and Field Manual procedures.

steps.title: Slack DM / side chat
steps.body: Use for Morning Brief and prep — never #operations for those.

steps.title: Written record
steps.body: Group chats that scroll away are not a record. Write CO facts down.

warnings.title: Friendly answers do not pay
warnings.body: Calling the wrong person gets sympathy, not authorization. Climb the ladder until someone with actual authority says yes — or stop until they do.

warnings.title: Unsafe access / stop conditions
warnings.body: Lead stops work first. Escalate to ops lead; office if ACM, lead, or structural issues are involved. Do not resume until someone with authority clears it.

variations.title: How do we build this detail?
changes: First call: Lead (Full detail in Field Manual)

variations.title: Unsafe access / stop condition
changes: Escalate to: Ops lead; office if ACM/lead/structure

variations.title: Extra work / verbal add
changes: First call: Lead — stop, photo, write

variations.title: Drawings conflict
changes: First call: Lead — RFI, do not guess
Escalate to: Office / estimator as directed

variations.title: Locked out / no heat / no release
variations.when: Crew cannot work — standing-by may apply
changes: Escalate to: Ops lead; document standing-by

variations.title: Job Check / Monday wrong
variations.when: Board data does not match field truth

variations.title: Owner / GC political pressure
changes: Escalate to: Office; Jordan only for owner exceptions

quality_checks.prompt: Called the first person who can actually authorize the issue type
Stops, COs, and authority issues used a phone call — not only a scrolling chat
Scope/money facts written down when the path is a change order

common_mistakes.title: Calling the office for a build detail
common_mistakes.wrong: Skip the lead and call estimating for a hanger question
common_mistakes.right: Lead first, then ops lead for production authority
common_mistakes.why: The office cannot answer means-and-methods from the truck

common_mistakes.title: Texting a group chat for a stop
common_mistakes.wrong: Post "we stopped" in a channel and keep working
common_mistakes.right: Phone call to lead; stop until cleared
common_mistakes.why: Scrolling chats are not authority and not a record

common_mistakes.title: Morning Brief in #operations
common_mistakes.wrong: Post field brief or prep status to the operations channel
common_mistakes.right: Slack DM or side chat only
common_mistakes.why: Locked policy — never broadcast Morning Brief to #operations

common_mistakes.title: Climbing past the authorizer
common_mistakes.wrong: Keep calling up the ladder after someone with authority said no
common_mistakes.right: Stop at the person who can say yes; document and wait
common_mistakes.why: Jordan-only exceptions exist for a reason — do not shop for a yes
